Ive got a bitaxe 601 that isnt even 9 months old and it stopped
functioning,  i need to get it in and repaired or replaced.
Used route to tech
Note to the team: Handed to our technical specialist, who takes it from here.

The unit will sometimes power up the fan, but that is all, no
screenl,led,light, or other signs of life. I put multimeter leads at
soldered joint for 5v power in and with the fan running it had 5.4v, the
same as if testing at power supply barrel with it not connected.
Used the store-orders skill
Handed to the team · RMA approval is JD's or Georges' call; I cannot approve it myself.

Hi Christopher,

Thanks for doing that test, it tells us a lot. With 5.4V sitting right at the input joint while the fan spins and nothing else wakes up, the power side is fine and the fault is on the board itself. That is not something you can fix at your end, so it goes to warranty.

I've pulled your order up, Shop····, the Bitaxe Gamma 601 that was delivered on March 9, so you're well inside the window for this. Your case is with our hardware lead now for the warranty approval. Once that is signed off I'll send you a prepaid return label and the return reference to write on the box, and we arrange the replacement from there. You don't need to fill anything in or ship anything yet.

One thing worth telling me in your reply: was the unit ever overclocked or modified? Stock units are covered, overclocked ones aren't, so it just saves a round trip later.

The team is offline this evening and picks this up tomorrow from 10am Eastern, and the answer comes straight back to you in this thread. If you'd like a faster second opinion on the board in the meantime, our Discord is at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, where JD (@nullhashrate) and the community are very active.

Sorry it quit on you this early, we'll get it sorted.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
Never modified or overclocked

Hi Christopher,

That's what I needed, thank you. A stock, never modified unit is fully covered, so there's nothing standing in the way on your side.

Your return is with the team for final approval now. They pick it up tomorrow from 10am Eastern and you'll get the confirmation straight back in this thread. As soon as it's signed off I'll send you the prepaid return label and the return reference to write on the outside of the box, and we'll sort the replacement from there.

Nothing to do in the meantime. If you can keep the unit boxed up with its power supply, you'll be ready to drop it off the moment the label lands.

Sorry again that it went down this early on you.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
